title: VS Code window
description: Clank's VS Code window, a separate instance of VS Code (its settings and extensions under CLANK_HOME/vscode, the main one untouched): which program runs it, and the extensions it has besides Clank's own.

schema.title: Schema
schema.description: The kind and version this file is written in; always its first field.

title.description: The name clients show for this record; the file's own name when empty.
title.title: Title

program.description: VS Code's command line and any arguments before VS Code's own; empty: `code` found on the PATH (on Windows, the program its code.cmd runs).
program.title: Program

extensions.description: The extensions installed in the window when missing, by their marketplace ids (publisher.name), besides Clank's own: Python, Pylance, the debugger, Ruff, Jupyter, Lean 4, LaTeX Workshop, a PDF viewer, Rainbow CSV, Markdown All in One, Mermaid and Even Better TOML.
extensions.title: Extensions

ssh_host.description: This PC's name in the SSH configuration of the computer you work from (design 0018 §8): over SSH, outside VS Code's Remote-SSH, Clank says the command that opens a folder there with it; empty: the address the SSH session came in on.
ssh_host.title: SSH host
